import re

def slugify(text: str) -> str:
    """Turn arbitrary text into a URL slug: lowercase, ASCII letters and
    digits, words separated by single hyphens, no leading/trailing hyphens."""
    text = text.lower()
    # replace any non-alphanumeric ASCII characters with hyphens
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "-", text)
    # collapse multiple consecutive hyphens into a single hyphen
    text = re.sub(r"-+", "-", text)
    # strip leading/trailing hyphens
    text = text.strip("-")
    return text

arguments.summary: Fixed slugify to collapse consecutive hyphens and strip leading/trailing hyphens. Kept public signature and behavior: lowercase, replace non-alphanumerics with hyphens, then collapse multiple hyphens and strip hyphens.
